pageCache.pageTitle: Breaside Preparatory School - Private Independent School in Kent
pageCache.text:
View assessment dates & apply
Welcome to Breaside Preparatory School
Located in Bromley, Kent, Breaside Preparatory School provides a rich learning environment for your son or daughter. Our curriculum will prepare your children for the senior schools of choice through a balanced and broadly based education, from their first days in Kindergarten through to the age of 11. We believe in getting the basics right and teaching the core subjects with a mixture of traditional teaching styles with the more modern approaches to learning. Coupled together with a strong work ethic and an enriching learning environment, we are confident that we help each child to develop towards their full potential.
Outstanding Education
We are extremely proud to have been graded as Excellent / Outstanding for the last 10+ years. Our latest inspection in November 2021 by the Independent Schools Inspectorate (ISI) graded us as "EXCELLENT" in all areas, the top grade and an amazing achievement!
Excellent Results
Breaside once again recognised as one of the Top Independent Prep Schools in the prestigious Sunday Times Parent Power Guide 2023. Ranked 18th within the Sunday Times Top 100 UK Schools.
Extra Curricular Activities
Children enjoy school outside the curriculum, with an extensive range of clubs from Tae Kwon-do, Spanish, Elocution, Cross Country, Choir, Cookery Club, Ballet and many more.
I am delighted that you have decided to find out more about Breaside Preparatory School. I hope that our website contains all of the information you need and that you enjoy your virtual tour.
“Breaside is a happy school with a kind and caring ethos. Our aim is to provide excellence in education."
- Karen Nicholson, Executive Principal
We are proud to have the Millie’s Mark accreditation
Millie's Mark is awarded to childcare providers exceeding EYFS guidelines by having every Early Years staff member trained in paediatric first aid. We are very proud to be recognised as the ONLY school in the Bromley area with this award. This ensures maximum child safety. This accolade requires 100% staff training and upholding first aid knowledge, offering parents peace of mind.
Join us for a Personal Tour
We warmly welcome families throughout the year, offering tailored personal tours on a day that suits you, including school holidays.
FACILITIES & LOCATION
A rich learning environment
Breaside is a warm and welcoming Prep School in Bromley, Kent where children benefit from great facilities both on and off site. Surrounded by natural beauty and tranquillity, Breaside Preparatory School provides an ideal space for academic growth and holistic development. Children are encouraged to explore and learn about the natural environment, and how to problem solve working as a team and take risks. They also learn to develop many skills for the future.
Nurturing young minds at every level
We have specialist subject teachers who teach Science, French, Music, Creative Art and Sports from Kindergarten onwards. We believe in getting the basics right and teaching the core subjects with a mixture of traditional teaching styles and more modern approaches to learning.
Begin an unforgettable adventure
Next Steps

History & Ethos
Unique opportunities where children celebrate individuality
Breaside has a character all of its own – a real ‘buzz’ around the building, from our youngest children in the Early Years all the way up to our Year 6 children preparing for the next steps in their journey. It is this buzz that captures the heart of Breaside, a truly unique place where importance is placed on celebrating the individual and the belief that all of our children can be anything that they want to be. Our school is a place where children are happy, confident and proud of their achievements, both inside and out of the classroom.
Inspiring a true love of learning
Fostering independence and resilience is key to our ethos, and empowering our children by equipping them with the skills and opportunities to become a global citizen of the future.
To celebrate each child individually offering a personalised child-centred journey.
To inspire a lifelong love of learning through outstanding teaching and a broad range of enrichment opportunities.
To provide the highest quality pastoral care with an emphasis on character and well-being.
To empower our children as global citizens, giving them a voice and an understanding of the world around them.
Join us for a Personal Tour
We warmly welcome families throughout the year, offering tailored personal tours on a day that suits you, including school holidays.
Next Steps

About Us
Part of the Cognita Global Family
By being part of the Cognita family, we open the door to a global community of over 100 schools that’s rich in knowledge, opportunities, and best practices, ensuring every child gets an education that’s, quite literally, world class. We are proud to be part of this community and actively help to shape it. Each school within the Cognita family preserves its distinct character and remains deeply rooted in its local community. Crucially, these diverse experiences across the world foster inspiration, shared support, and growth opportunities for every school within our group. Our students and teachers are more than just learners and educators; they are active global citizens. Together, they are exposed to a variety of perspectives from diverse cultures, sharing and gaining insights that transcend traditional classroom boundaries. This dynamic exchange fosters a learning space where young minds, guided by their teachers, are encouraged to express their unique ideas and talents, while instilling the value of respect and embracing the spirit of collaboration. It’s an individual approach that empowers our school, every teacher, and each student to discover what they truly do best. And thrive.
Proprietor: Cognita 41-42 Eastcastle Street, London, W1W 8DY Phone: +44 (0)20 7636 8444
Chief Executive Officer, Europe (Interim): Oli Williams Director of Education (DE): Sarah Reynolds Chair of Govenors (DE): James Carroll

pageCache.pageTitle: Breaside Adventure Holiday Club - Breaside Preparatory School
pageCache.text:
Breaside Adventure Holiday Club
Breaside Adventurers Holiday Camp
With a perfect balance of fun and education, our Breaside Adventurers Holiday Camp offer a variety of activities, from outdoor exploration to creative endeavours. There are lots of different activities scheduled and the timetable rotates each day:
Sports and exercise classes
Sessions start at 8.00am and finish at 5.00pm. Children should be collected promptly at 5pm.
Join us for a Personal Tour
We warmly welcome families throughout the year, offering tailored personal tours on a day that suits you, including school holidays.
Where to find us
Our Breaside Adventurers Holiday Camp is based at Breaside @ Orchard Road 41-43 Orchard Road Bromley Kent BR1 2PR

Extra-Curricular
Beyond the Classroom
At Breaside Preparatory School, we believe that education extends beyond the classroom. Our extra-curricular program is a testament to our commitment to providing a well-rounded education for our pupils. Through a diverse range of activities and clubs, we encourage our pupils to explore their interests, develop new skills, and build lifelong friendships. Whether it's sports, music, drama, or academic enrichment, our extra-curricular offerings cater to a wide spectrum of interests and talents.
Clubs and Activities
School trips
Instrumental Lessons
Choir
Football
Computing
Music & Movement
Chess & Board Games
Cricket
Debating
Mandarin
Netball
Funky Jazz
Multisports
Speech & Drama
Rounders
Tae Kwon-Do
Drama
Creative Writing
Creative Art
Orchestra
Tennis
Elocution
Exploring Beyond the Classroom
We believe that learning does not just take place within the classroom and a variety of trips to places of interest are organised for each year group throughout the year. In Year 5, the pupils are offered the opportunity of taking part in an activities week in Dorset, where they can try a variety of outward-bound activities. The Year 6 trip to France gives our pupils the opportunity to practise their language skill as well as continue their outdoor pursuits.
Join us for a Personal Tour
We warmly welcome families throughout the year, offering tailored personal tours on a day that suits you, including school holidays.
Instrumental lessons
Instrumental and Vocal Tuition at Breaside
Over 180 students receive instrumental or vocal lessons each week at Breaside and we have a large team of experienced specialist music teachers. Lessons are either provided by staff from Bromley Youth Music Trust (known as BYMT) or by self-employed visiting music teachers. Lessons take place during the school day. Pupils come out of lessons to attend, but the timetable is worked out on a rotation basis so they do not miss the same lesson each week. We are currently able to offer individual lessons to pupils who are in Years 1-6 on the following instruments:
Other instruments include: Drums and Piano

Wraparound Care
Breaside care and support
Breaside recognises and understands the need for out of hours childcare for our parents. Places are limited, but we are here to help and will do everything in our power to accommodate your children.
Breakfast club
Our Breakfast Club sessions operate Monday – Friday 7.15am – 8.10am. These sessions are run by our Head of Early Years and Breaside Staff. Parents can drop their children off from 7.15am at the Main Hall door and the session finishes at 8.10am. This provision is charged at an additional £6.00 a session. A light and healthy breakfast is provided which can include toast (brown or white bread) with Jam, Marmite or Honey. Children can also choose from a selection of cereals. Parents can book Breakfast Club sessions in advance within their ParentPay account.
After School Care
After School Care operates from 3.15pm until 6.00pm in the Hall and is run by our experienced Breaside Staff.
To offer our families flexibility, slots for After School Care can be booked in advance. However, if you experience any unplanned delays and are unable to book we will charge retrospectively.
Pricing for After School Care is as follows:
End of school day through to 4pm: £6
4pm through to 4:30pm: £4
4:30pm through to 5pm: £4
5pm through to 5:30pm: £4
5:30pm through to 6pm: £4
Late Collection: £20
Our After-School Care team is run by our Breaside Staff.
Parents can book sessions for After School Care in advance within their ParentPay account. ParentPay can be accessed via Cognita Connect Payments and all wraparound care bookings can be found within your child’s profile on ParentPay.
Breaside Adventurers Holiday Camp
Breaside Adventurers is run by our professional and qualified Breaside staff during the school holidays. There are lots of different activities including sports and exercise classes, arts & crafts, construction, dance and music, and lots more. Sessions run from 8.00am to 5.00pm and charged at £40 per session with a 15% sibling discount. The team can be contacted during the sessions on: Tel: 07887 656819 or E: breasideadventurers@breaside.co.uk Please book early to avoid disappointment. Bookings are made on ParentPay via Cognita Connect Payments.
Join us for a Personal Tour
We warmly welcome families throughout the year, offering tailored personal tours on a day that suits you, including school holidays.

Careers
Thank you for your interest in joining our wonderful team here at Breaside Preparatory School.
Here at Breaside we recognise that teaching isn’t just a job or profession – it’s a vocation. Therefore we seek to recruit and develop outstanding professionals who want to make a positive difference to children’s lives and who can help us stretch and support children to achieve more than they believe they can.
To view and apply for our current vacancies please visit the Cognita Careers site below:

Early Years
Ready to start their adventure
Our Early Years is a happy place where children are motivated and encouraged to learn from the tender age of 2½ up to 5 years. - Kindergarten is for children aged 2½ to 3½ years - Pre-Prep is from 3½ to 4½ years - Reception from aged 4+ when the academic year starts in the September following their fourth birthday.
A caring nurturing environment
Our dedicated team of experienced Early Years Teaching Staff creates an enriching learning environment, offering a blend of exciting challenges and a nurturing atmosphere to support children's academic growth. Our educational journey begins in Kindergarten, covering the nursery years, and marks the beginning of each child’s prep school journey. From here, children progress through Early Years and Infants, culminating in the Juniors. Each stage is carefully designed to prepare children for their secondary school experience. Children aged 2-5 benefit from the Cool Milk scheme, receiving fresh cow's milk, healthy snacks, and lunches daily. Additionally, we offer outstanding wrap-around care services, including breakfast and after-school clubs, as well as a wide range of after-school activities and clubs to enhance their overall development.
Millie’s Mark Award
Breaside has earned Millie's Mark, a significant accomplishment for our school. We appreciate our dedicated staff's hard work and commitment to exceeding health and safety standards and pediatric first aid requirements. Millie's Mark is a special endorsement granted to childcare providers who surpass the minimum criteria by ensuring that 100% of staff are trained in pediatric first aid and that this knowledge remains current and confidently applied by practitioners.
Join us for a Personal Tour
We warmly welcome families throughout the year, offering tailored personal tours on a day that suits you, including school holidays.
What will your child learn in Early Years?
Children start to learn about the world around them from the moment they are born. The care and education offered by Breaside Early Years helps children to continue to do this by providing all children with interesting activities that are tailored to their age and stage of development. All of the Early Years year groups enjoy busy, well planned and stimulating daily timetables with an excellent mix of academic, fun and calming activities across the whole day.
PE & Gymnastics
Our youngest learners at our school are introduced to a diverse range of physical education activities. Through PE and Gymnastics, they develop their physical strength and coordination, while Yoga promotes mindfulness and flexibility.
Language classes
Our youngest children are immersed in a world of languages, with the chance to explore French and Spanish. Taught by specialist teachers, these language classes not only introduce linguistic skills but also nurture independence and confidence, setting a strong foundation for their future journeys.
Music
Music lessons not only introduce children to the joys of melody and rhythm but it also helps them cultivate independence and confidence, providing a solid foundation for their future endeavours.
Begin an unforgettable adventure

Inspection Reports
Excellent in all areas 2023
Breaside were delighted to have achieved ‘EXCELLENT’ in all areas, following our ISI Inspection in December 2021.
The ISI New Framework 23 and Grades
Under this new framework overall judgement and grades are no longer provided by ISI. Instead, the inspection report is structured around five key areas, where the inspectors meticulously detail commendations for 'Standards Met'. We are delighted that Breaside Preparatory School received the highest possible rating of 'Standards Met' across all five areas. This is testament to the hard work and dedication of our remarkable team.
Report highlights:
“Pupils develop warm and supportive relationships with others and treat them with respect.”
"Teaching enables children in early years to communicate clearly and be confident when approaching new challenges. Children are prepared well for moving into Year 1."
“The school provides a wide range of extra-curricular provision. Clubs and activities enable pupils to participate in new experiences where they acquire additional skills and understanding whilst developing new interests.”
“In the early years, staff respond positively to children when they select their own activities and share their observations, thus supporting the children’s confidence and self-esteem.”
“Leaders make use of weekly assemblies to reinforce expectations about appropriate social conduct outside school. As a result of these experiences, pupils develop their social skills, confidence and sense of responsibility.”
“Leaders make use of weekly assemblies to reinforce expectations about appropriate social conduct outside school”
Proud of our school
We are particularly delighted that an external, independent body has not only recognised the excellent school that we are, but also that that they have captured the essence of who we are. Highlighting how we build in our pupils the confidence and strength of character to become the ‘changemakers of tomorrow’s world’.
Join us for a Personal Tour
We warmly welcome families throughout the year, offering tailored personal tours on a day that suits you, including school holidays.
December 2017 ISI Regulatory Compliance Inspection Report
“The school aims to foster a caring atmosphere in which pupils and teachers are aware of and sympathetic to the needs of others. It seeks to encourage every pupil to achieve their very best and be become responsible individuals who can work together co-operatively and with respect for their peers.” “The school offers all pupils a range of enrichment and extension tasks in lessons and in extra-curricular activities.” “The standards relating to the quality of education at Breaside are met.” “The standards relating to spiritual, moral, social and cultural development are met.”

Juniors
An enriched learning environment
In our Junior Years, our dedicated team is committed to nurturing young minds in a supportive and engaging environment. As part of our independent prep school, we offer a rich curriculum that inspires curiosity and fosters a love for learning, with a strong focus on holistic development. Explore our Junior Years program, where your child will embark on an exciting educational journey filled with exploration, creativity, and the building blocks for a bright future.
Our Approach
Pastoral Care
Encouraging academic success
In our Juniors, children benefit from the highest standards of teaching, alongside the individual attention they need in the lead-up to their 11+ examinations at the end of Year 6. As a leading private school, we support and encourage children to build the strongest possible foundations for a school life full of excitement, interest and, above all, opportunity. Parent consultations with the Headteacher and staff are a priority in supporting the important decisions families make. This is a true partnership, where pupils, teachers and parents work together to explore options and choices.
Specialist Teaching
Our curriculum is designed to meet our objective of preparing children for senior schools. In addition, we attach great importance to providing all children with a balanced and broadly based education, from their first days in the Kindergarten through to the age of 11. In Years 3 and 4, form tutors continue to be responsible for teaching English, Maths & PSHE, although the children now receive specialist teaching in ICT, Science, History, Geography & Religious Education as well. These two years see a consolidation of the Key Stage 1 work as the children begin to prepare for their 11+ entrance tests and Key Stage 2 SATs. In Years 5 and 6, Breaside’s unique preparation for entrance exams to over 20 different Secondary School is key.
Science
Science is taught by a specialist teacher supported by a science technician in a dedicated, fully resourced vibrant classroom to pupils from Year 2 to Year 6. We have an interactive whiteboard, a dedicated set of i-pads and access to numerous and varied IT resources to support the teaching of science topics.
French & Spanish
French & Spanish are taught from Kindergarten to Year 6 and an annual trip to France in Year 6 gives our children the opportunity to practise the language skills that they have learnt. Spanish club is also on offer and as a school we are very aware of the future needs of our children in the global economy in which we live.
Art & Design Technology / Food Technology
All Breaside children participate in art, design technology and craft activities where they can develop their powers of observation, technical skill, presentation and individual creativity. As part of their curriculum food technology is now also included, and in addition there are cookery clubs for both Infants and Juniors.
Join us for a Personal Tour
We warmly welcome families throughout the year, offering tailored personal tours on a day that suits you, including school holidays.
Enjoy the highest standards of teaching
In Years 3, 4, 5 and 6 form teachers continue to be responsible for the pastoral care and welfare of the children in their respective form. Year 3 children see a consolidation of the Key Stage 1 work as the children begin to prepare for their 11+ entrance tests and Key Stage 2 SATs. Breaside children can enjoy the highest standards of teaching together with the individual attention that they need in the lead up to their Entrance Tests and 11+ examinations in Year 6. We're extremely proud of our continued success in achieving the highest standards of education and ensuring every child reaches their full potential and gains a place in the best possible school for the individual.
Exploring beyond the classroom
We believe that learning does not just take place within the classroom and a variety of trips to places of interest are organised for each year group throughout the year. In Year 5, the pupils are offered the opportunity of taking part in an activities week in Dorset, where they can try a variety of outward-bound activities. An annual trip to France in Year 6 gives our children the opportunity to practise the language skills that they have learned.
Begin an unforgettable adventure

Leavers' Destinations
Preparing for secondary school
We have an excellent record of places gained to local super selective grammars and independent schools and this year is no exception. Our 11+ results were once again outstanding with some pupils offered academic, creative, music and sports scholarships. Parents are given guidance on the schools that we recommend for their children throughout their time at Breaside and we pride ourselves on gaining the right opportunities for individual children.
Please see attachments for lists of places offered over the past few years:
Join us for a Personal Tour
We warmly welcome families throughout the year, offering tailored personal tours on a day that suits you, including school holidays.

pageCache.pageTitle: Open Days & Visits - Breaside Preparatory School
pageCache.text:
Open Mornings & Visits
Come and visit us
At Breaside, we know that choosing the right school is a big decision, and nothing brings our community to life quite like a visit. Whether you join us for one of our Open Mornings, book a private tour, or come along to our Picnic in the Park, you’ll have the chance to see what makes our school such a special place to learn and grow.
Our Open Morning events are a great opportunity to discover what makes Breaside such a great school for our children. Held once a term across both our Orchard Road and Widmore Road sites, these events offer the chance to explore the school, meet our team, and see our pupils in action. Led by one of our pupils, these events give you the opportunity to meet our dedicated staff, and get a real feel for daily life at Breaside.
Widmore Road Open Morning - Thursday 8 October - 9am
Orchard Road Open Morning - Thursday 15 October - 9am
If you're unable to attend one of our Open Mornings or would prefer a more personal introduction to Breaside, we’re happy to offer private tours. These are led by a member of our admissions team, who will be on hand to show you around and answer any questions you may have. To arrange a tour, simply fill in the form via the link below and let us know a time that suits you. We'll be in touch as soon as possible to confirm the details.
Breaside @ Orchard Road 41-43 Orchard Road Bromley Kent BR1 2PR
Breaside @ Widmore Road 116 Widmore Road Bromley BR1 3BE
Next Steps

Academic Excellence
Elevating Child Potential
At Breaside, our aim is to challenge and empower all children, fostering their potential. We prioritise identifying, supporting, and nurturing gifted students, offering a diverse curriculum and extra curricular activities. We advance children in English, Math, Science, the Arts, and Sports. Alongside classroom experiences, we offer challenge days, workshops, and competitions. Breaside's links with our local community provide opportunities for skill development. Recent collaborations include Math contests, coding masterclasses, and Tomorrow's Achievers workshops and Challenge Days.
Top School in Bromley
We are pleased that Breaside has once again featured and ranked 18th in the Sunday Times Top 100 Independent Preparatory Schools in the UK. This guide identifies 600 of the highest achieving primary and prep schools ranked by the most recent examination results. We have an outstanding record of places gained to the super selective local grammars and the many independent schools in the local and wider area and this year is no exception. Our 11+ results were once again amazing with a number of pupils being offered academic, creative, music and sports scholarships. The scholarship offers vary from school to school. Parents are given guidance on the schools that we recommend for their children throughout their time at Breaside and we pride ourselves on getting the children into the right school for them as individuals. Below are our impressive Key Stage 2 results, which over the years have been consistently well above the national average.
Join us for a Personal Tour
We warmly welcome families throughout the year, offering tailored personal tours on a day that suits you, including school holidays.
Your child's journey at Breaside
We understand the importance of providing parents with comprehensive guidance to ensure the best educational journey for their children. Our commitment lies in carefully working with each child's unique needs and capabilities, enabling us to make tailored recommendations for their future schools. We take great pride in our personalised approach, which focuses on finding the perfect fit for each individual. By doing so, we strive to create a solid foundation for their academic and personal journey, fostering a bright and promising future.

Character Development
Inspiring inclusive learning and empowerment
We take great pride in our long-standing academic success and place high importance on inspiring a true love of learning that extends beyond our classrooms, through a wide range of learning opportunities. Fostering independence and resilience is key to our ethos and empowering our children by equipping them with the right balance of skills for the future ensures that they have the best start for their role in the global community. We believe in a wholly inclusive education, focussed equally on academic rigour and a wider enriched curriculum, that gives our children the opportunity to flourish on a journey that is personalised to them.
Care and commitment
An exceptional level of pastoral care is paramount to our culture, and we firmly believe that it is our staff, parents and most importantly, our children that make Breaside so special. Because of this, each member of our school community is truly dedicated to making sure that every child’s Breaside experience is the best that it possibly can be.
Join us for a Personal Tour
We warmly welcome families throughout the year, offering tailored personal tours on a day that suits you, including school holidays.

pageCache.pageTitle: Friends of Breaside - Breaside Preparatory School
pageCache.text:
Friends of Breaside
Welcome to Friends of Breaside
At Breaside we have a highly motivated and fully active parents’ association, known as “Friends of Breaside” who organise and run a whole variety of social events giving the parents the opportunities to meet. Our Summer Fair is one of the highlights of the year along with quiz nights, ladies’ nights and a Summer Ball. The Association also raises funds for the “luxury” items that the school needs and its finances are totally separate from that of the school.
Foster more extended relationships between the staff, parents and others associated with the School.
Engage in activities which support the School and advance the education of the pupils attending it.
Provide and assist in the provision of such facilities or items for the education at the school not provided by Cognita Limited.
The Friends of Breaside is run by a committee, which consists of Chairman, Vice-chairman, Treasurer, Secretary and a representative from each class, along with the Headteacher and a staff representative. Any teacher or parent is welcome to attend any committee meeting. The AGM is held in the first few weeks the Spring term. It is also a registered charity. The committee also runs a second-hand uniform shop 'Breaside Boutique' which is located at the Orchard Road School and is open Tuesday and Thursday mornings from 8.20am – 8.40am, this also sells school tracksuits and stationery at competitive prices.

Our Community
Charity Fund Raising & Events
Breaside Preparatory School enriches lives locally and globally. Our commitment to community engagement is at our core. We create links early with our parents by holding events, such as Summer and Christmas Fayres, coffee mornings, parents transition evenings, Mother’s Day and afternoon teas. We actively encourage parents to be part of Breaside life. At Breaside we support a range of local and national charities such as Harvest, Rememberance Day, Red Nose Day, Jeans for Genes, Children in Need and MacMillan Cancer Care Coffee Morning. The staff, pupils and parents of Breaside organise raffles, sponsored events and lots of fun activities to support these charities and are always incredibly generous. We support a range of local and national charities such as:
MacMillan Cancer Care Coffee Morning
Bromley Brighter Beginnings
As always, you have given so generously to the Poppy Appeal and it has been wonderful to see the children wear their poppies with such pride these past weeks.
We received our certificate from Hayes Royal British Legion confirming we had raised an amazing £715.75 The number of warm hats, scarves, gloves and donations gifted to Bromley Brighter Beginnings (organised by FoBs) was absolutely wonderful – they will all be so very gratefully received.
How wonderful that on World Kindness Day 2020, we have come together as a school to support the amazing and crucial work of Children in Need.
We have been so impressed by the readiness of our children to help make a difference to the lives of children and their families around the UK. This level of kindness does not stop there however, and this week has most definitely seen the Breaside community come together in a week of giving to others. The final total from Children in Need is an amazing £710! Thank you so much for your generosity! Thank you Breaside – your kindness and generosity are phenomenal and together our school community has made such a difference to many.
We would like to say a huge “thank you” for your Harvest Donation this year. In light of the Covid 19 pandemic, we were amazed by the innovative and generous amount we have received.

pageCache.pageTitle: Pastoral Care and Wellbeing at - Breaside Preparatory School
pageCache.text:
Wellbeing at Breaside
We believe that happy children learn best. When a child feels settled, confident, and cared for, they're free to explore, discover, and grow into the person they're meant to be. At Breaside, looking after each child's wellbeing is at the heart of everything we do. Every child who walks through our doors brings their own story, their own personality, and their own way of seeing the world. We celebrate these differences and work hard to make sure every single child feels they belong here. When children feel truly accepted for who they are, they develop the confidence to be themselves.
A nurturing environment
From the moment children arrive, they're welcomed into a community that truly knows them. Our small class sizes mean every teacher understands each child's unique personality, strengths, and needs. When children feel genuinely seen and heard, they naturally flourish.
Building emotional resilience
We help children develop the tools they need to navigate life's ups and downs. Through gentle guidance, children learn to understand their emotions, build confidence, and develop the resilience that will serve them throughout their lives.
Supporting the whole family
We know that when families feel supported, children thrive. Our open-door policy means parents can always reach out with concerns or questions. Whether it's a challenging day at home or celebrating a breakthrough moment, we're here to listen and support.
Staff awareness
Our staff are trained to recognise when a child might need additional support, and we work closely with families and external professionals when needed. Every child's wellbeing journey looks different, and we're committed to providing the right support at the right time.
Creating lasting foundations
The wellbeing skills children develop at Breaside - kindness, empathy, self-awareness, and emotional intelligence - become the foundation for everything that follows. We're not just preparing children for their next school. We’re helping them develop the emotional tools for a happy, healthy life.

Welcome to Breaside Preparatory School
Located in Bromley, Kent, Breaside Preparatory School provides a rich learning environment for your son or daughter. Our curriculum will prepare your children for the senior schools of choice through a balanced and broadly based education, from their first days in Kindergarten through to the age of 11. We believe in getting the basics right and teaching the core subjects with a mixture of traditional teaching styles with the more modern approaches to learning. Coupled together with a strong work ethic and an enriching learning environment, we are confident that we help each child to develop towards their full potential.
Outstanding Education
We are extremely proud to have been graded as Excellent / Outstanding for the last 10+ years. Our latest inspection in November 2021 by the Independent Schools Inspectorate (ISI) graded us as "EXCELLENT" in all areas, the top grade and an amazing achievement!
Excellent Results
Breaside once again recognised as one of the Top Independent Prep Schools in the prestigious Sunday Times Parent Power Guide 2023. Ranked 18th within the Sunday Times Top 100 UK Schools.
Extra Curricular Activities
Children enjoy school outside the curriculum, with an extensive range of clubs from Tae Kwon-do, Spanish, Elocution, Cross Country, Choir, Cookery Club, Ballet and many more.
I am delighted that you have decided to find out more about Breaside Preparatory School. I hope that our website contains all of the information you need and that you enjoy your virtual tour.
“Breaside is a happy school with a kind and caring ethos. Our aim is to provide excellence in education."
- Karen Nicholson, Executive Principal
We are proud to have the Millie’s Mark accreditation
Millie's Mark is awarded to childcare providers exceeding EYFS guidelines by having every Early Years staff member trained in paediatric first aid. We are very proud to be recognised as the ONLY school in the Bromley area with this award. This ensures maximum child safety. This accolade requires 100% staff training and upholding first aid knowledge, offering parents peace of mind.
